protocol.target_policy: Observed today and yesterday, >=4 contiguous context days after max 2-day ffill; long gaps reset context
protocol.training_policy: Expanding walk-forward, dates strictly earlier than target; hyperparameters fixed; no test-set tuning
protocol.availability_limit: Observation-date backtest: historical first-seen/capture times are retained but not enforced as intraday publication cutoffs
protocol.scope: Next-day category/chain cheapest price; no claim of same-SKU accuracy or weekly-horizon improvement
protocol.timesfm_usage: Research evaluation only; no production model change

persistence.interpretation: Negative MAE delta is improvement; only eight test days, exploratory interval.
